name: STIHL MS 291
blurb: 16″, 18″ and 20″ bars on .325″ chain, .063″ gauge, 67–81 drive links, per STIHL's chain-selection chart.
intro: The STIHL MS 291 appears in STIHL's saw-chain selection chart with 16″, 18″ and 20″ guide bars: the same .325″ pitch, .063″ gauge chain family as the MS 261 and MS 271. The round file for that family is published two ways. STIHL’s file table names 11/64″ (4.5 mm) and 3/16″ (4.8 mm) without picking a loop, and Oregon’s chart names 3/16″. The file column keeps both.

bars.note: STIHL's chart lists chain 26 RM3 67 with recommended bar 3003 812 7013.
STIHL's chart lists chain 26 RM3 74 with recommended bar 3003 812 7017.
STIHL's chart lists chain 26 RM3 81 with recommended bar 3003 812 7021.

sources.title: Saw Chain Selection and Identification (STIHL USA catalog page 173; specifications as of 1 October 2017): recommended chain loop and guide bar per saw model

STIHL 2025 Full Line catalog, file table (catalog p. 167): .325″ round files in 4.5 mm (11/64″, part 7010 871 0402) and 4.8 mm (3/16″, part 7010 871 0403). The table does not assign one size to a loop.
Saw Chain Filing Angles chart (2020): 3/16″ round file for .325″ chain (types 95VPX, 95TXL, and 20, 21, 22 BPX and LPX)

sources_note: STIHL USA “Saw Chain Selection and Identification” chart (catalog page 173, specifications as of 1 October 2017), read on 24 Oct 2026. Drive-link counts were left on that chart. The file column cites the STIHL 2025 catalog file table (p. 167, both .325″ files) and Oregon’s 2020 Filing Angles chart (3/16″ for .325″ types 95, 20, 21 and 22), read 3 Nov 2026.
